info.name: VAC Premises API
info.description:
**VAC Premises API** is an on-premise integration platform designed for organizations that require secure and direct access to their telephony, CRM, and communication systems.

  
It enables seamless connectivity between internal applications, PBX systems, dialers, WhatsApp services, and enterprise workflows through robust APIs.

  
Built for reliability and complete infrastructure control, VAC Premises API ensures secure data handling within the customer’s own environment.

  
The platform helps businesses automate operations, streamline communication processes, and integrate enterprise systems efficiently.

It wont't support inbuilt HTTPS SSL Certificate. SSL certificate is customer scope. VAC Cloud APIs which will support HTTPS is commerical involved for the Premises customers.

item.description:
This guide provides instructions for integrating a 3rd Party Application with a **VAC Dialer or Customer Care system**. The integration involves using various APIs provided by the VAC Team to enable seamless communication and data exchange.

**The Operations:**

- dial - Manual Dial
    
- BTxer - Blind Transfer
    
- ATxer - Attended Transfer
    
- Grab - Grab the Customer
    
- Leave2Way - Leave 3 Way Call
    
- HangupTxer - Disconnect the 3rd Line Call
    
- Hangup Both - Disconnect the Conference Call
    
- logRequest - getting Call log of the number
    
- addLead - Auto Dial add number from webforms.
    

**Integration Steps:**

- Obtain the API endpoints and parameters from both the VAC Team
    
- Ensure that the parameters are correctly passed in the API calls for seamless integration.
    
- Test the integration thoroughly to verify functionality and data exchange between the applications.
    
- Monitor and troubleshoot any issues that may arise during integration to ensure smooth operation.
    

By following these steps, you can successfully integrate your 3rd Party Application with the VAC Dialer/Customer Care system, enabling enhanced communication capabilities and streamlined call management.

**VAC DIaler Web Hooks:**

Operations:

1. Call Popup Webhook
    
2. Call Starting Event Webhook
    
3. Call Ending Event Webhook
    

**1\. Call Popup Webhook:**

**a. API Provided:** 3rd Party Application will provide the API endpoint.  
**b. Method:** GET or POST  
**c. Params**  
**i.** \`phone_number\`: Customer's phone number (can be named differently as per API)  
**ii. Example URL:** Any URL provided by the 3rd Party API

**2\. Call Start Event Webhook:**

**a. API Provided:** 3rd Party Application will provide the API endpoint.  
**b. Method:** GET or POST  
**c. Params:**  
**i.** \`phone_number\`: Customer's phone number  
**ii.** \`agent\`: Agent ID  
**iii.** \`start_time\`: Timestamp of call start  
**iv.** \`campaign_name\`: Name of the campaign  
**v.** Additional params as required by the 3rd Party Application  
**d. Example URL:** Any URL provided by the 3rd Party API.

**3\. Call End Event Webhook:**

**a. API Provided:** 3rd Party Application will provide the API endpoint.  
**b. Method:** GET or POST  
**c. Params:**  
i. \`phone_number\`: Customer's phone number  
ii. \`agent\`: Agent ID  
iii. \`start_time\`: Timestamp of call start  
iv. \`campaign_name\`: Name of the campaign  
v. \`duration\`: Duration of the call  
vi. \`status\`: Call status (e.g., completed, missed)  
vii. \`recording_url\`: URL of the call recording  
viii. Additional params as required by the 3rd Party Application  
**d. Example URL:** Any URL provided by the 3rd Party API.

**Note: All the APIs are available. But we strongly recommend all calling operation should be used only in the dialer screen not by the any 3rd Party applications.(eg: Hold, Park, Grab, Call Transfer operations are strongly recommended to use only in the Dialer Screen for seamless operations).**
